name: Greatsword

body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
Statistics
Cost 50 gp Weight 8 lbs.
Damage 1d10 (small), 2d6 (medium); Critical 19-20/x2; Range —; Type S; Special —
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Blades, Heavy
Description
This immense two-handed sword is about 5 feet in length. A greatsword may have a dulled lower blade that can be gripped.
